facts.value: The Job Agency provides support in answering questions regarding personal goals and career orientation.
Goethe University offers career coaching to help students develop their individual profile and career orientation.
The Career Service offers feedback on the layout and style of application documents.
Career Service staff help optimize the wording and structure of applications.

Questions covered include how to write an attractive cover letter, how to align job advertisements with application documents, how to present individual competencies in the cover letter, and how to present work experiences in applications.
International students can seek assistance for the application process from the International Career Service.
Students can view the consulting offers of the Career Service in the consultation calendar and schedule appointments.
The Frankfurt Consultation Network, which includes Goethe University, offers support for students with doubts about their studies.
